name: GhostPiper v0.9.1
body:
# GhostPiper v0.9.1

## Fixed

- **Spurious mappings no longer appear in Ghostwriter.** Deploying findings to a report could silently auto-create library mappings on the *wrong* templates. The cause was a bundled ScoutSuite mapping file that pinned Ghostwriter template IDs which had since drifted out of sync with the live library. GhostPiper no longer ships hardcoded ScoutSuite template mappings: Ghostwriter is now the single source of truth, and mappings are created on the Mapping page (the same way Burp issues already work).

- **Mappings now carry across engagements.** Saved mappings no longer bake in engagement-specific scope: a Prowler finding's AWS account number and a Burp finding's target hostname are stripped before the mapping is stored. The same mapping now auto-matches the next engagement, and client hostnames / account numbers are no longer written into the shared template library.

## Upgrade notes

- After upgrading, open Settings and click **Sync** once so your local mapping cache rebuilds from Ghostwriter.
- If you previously saw incorrectly mapped findings, they have been cleaned up on the Ghostwriter side as part of this fix.
